answer: Each identity declares one home harbor city and must answer a hyperlocal question about it within 60 seconds each epoch — a street closure, a market price, a violet festival poster — facts only someone in that tundra town would know. A wrong or late answer freezes the identity and forfeits its 25.000 POA bond, half burned, half paid to the challenger. Running 1.000 fake identities means staffing 1.000 cities at once, costing 25.000.000 POA in bonds, while an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once for its own city. Limitation: a well-traveled operator could still fake several locales.
